units.source_text: 金阁犹如夜空中的明月，也是作为黑暗时代的象征而建造的。

en.t: The Golden Pavilion was like the bright moon in the night sky, and it had also been built as a symbol of an age of darkness.

units.source_text: 因此我梦幻的金阁以涌现在其四周的暗黑为背景。

en.t: Therefore, the Golden Pavilion of my dreams stood against a background of darkness surging up around it.

units.source_text: 在黑暗中，美丽而细长的柱子结构，从里面发出了微光，稳固而寂静地坐落在那里。

en.t: In the darkness, the beautiful, slender structure of its pillars gave off a faint light from within and stood there firmly and silently.

units.source_text: 不管人们对这幢建筑物做什么评语，美丽的金阁都是默默无言地裸露出它的纤细的结构，

en.t: No matter what people might say about this building, the beautiful Golden Pavilion silently laid bare its delicate structure,

units.source_text: 必须忍受着四周的黑暗。

en.t: and had to endure the darkness surrounding it.
